tools.name: food_list_destinations
tools.description:
Use this to list every destination served by the Quantum Atlas Global Food Hub with verified dining counts, structured menu coverage, statutory food tax rates, and per-city MCP URLs. Do not use this to search specific restaurants (use food_search_venues).

tools.name: food_search_venues
tools.description:
Use this to search publicly admitted restaurants, pubs, cafes, and bakeries by cuisine, dietary signal, or open_now status. Do not use this to load a venue's full dish list (use food_get_venue_menu) or search individual dishes across menus (use food_search_dishes).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge;

tools.description:
Use this to retrieve one venue's normalized JSON menu (atlas.agent_menu.v2) with menu_sha256, O(1) dietary_index, topping/sauce customization_catalog, and integer-cent prices. Do not use this to price a group cart (use food_estimate_group_cart).

tools.name: food_search_dishes
tools.description:
Use this to search individual menu items across all structured menus by dish keyword, dietary signal, allergen exclusions, or max_price_cents. Do not use this to browse venue-level metadata without menus (use food_search_venues).
Behavior: zero auth, zero charge; returns dish records sorted by price

tools.description:

tools.description:

tools.description:
Use this to evaluate whether a group can walk to a venue, wait, eat, and return within a strict door-to-door window (shore leave, ferry, or pre-show) including live kitchen wait and pickup fallback. Do not use this when no time cutoff applies (use food_search_venues).

tools.name: food_compile_structured_menu
tools.description:
Use this to convert raw unstructured restaurant menu text, Markdown, HTML, or OCR lines into a normalized atlas.agent_menu.v2 JSON package ($0.10) with menu_sha256 and dietary_index. Do not use this to read an already onboarded venue's menu (use food_get_venue_menu for free).
Behavior: costs $0.10 v

tools.name: food_attested_dining_brief
tools.description: Use this to generate a paid ($0.05) dining execution brief combining venues, open status, specials, municipal parking, statutory taxes, and cart splits sealed with an Ed25519 JWS execution attestation. Do not use this for un-attested free browsing (use food_search_venues or food_preview_paid_tool).

tools.name: food_package_multilingual_menu
tools.description:
Use this to compile a venue's verified structured menu and destination glossary into a pronunciation-safe 11-language hospitality brief and Switchboard payload ($0.25) with Ed25519 JWS attestation. Do not use this for English-only menu reads (use food_get_venue_menu).
Behavior: costs $0.25 via Strip

tools.name: food_preview_paid_tool
tools.description:
Use this to run a deterministic zero-cost sandbox dry-run of any paid Food Hub capability (food_attested_dining_brief, food_package_multilingual_menu, or food_compile_structured_menu) before spending. Do not use this when you need a real Ed25519 JWS receipt.
